work_done: Rebuilt my faithful oracle copy (bots/student-2/code/bg, diff vs canonical bg.cpp = identical).

Derived g-dependence by homogeneity counting of the BG engine: A_n(g) = g^(3-n) A_n(g=1). Source basis: on-shell K_i = sigma_i omega_i^2/g and Propagator D = wS^2/|kS| - g; the on-shell constraints are g-independent so the omega's and the closed-form structure do not move with g.
Cross-checked the exponent two independent ways (pure-omega scaling => degree 2n-4 at any g; combined omega->rho omega, g->rho^2 g => A_n -> rho^2 A_n).

Verified the g-restored closed form A_n = i g^(3-n) 2^(n-1) w1 w2 sum_S (-1)^|S| max(0,P-sum w_j^2)^(n-3) against ./bg, EXACT rational: 21/21 points at n=5,6,7 x g in {1,2,3} (principal/non-principal/extreme) residual 0; n=8 g in {1,2} exact; n=4 delta->0 limit at g=1 and g=2 exact.

Proved (symbolic/exact) that the accepted form is a B-spline / (n-2)-fold divided difference: operator form == subset sum; principal-chamber collapse to P^(n-3) (=> a_n=2^(n-1)w1 w2^(2n-5)); homogeneity 2n-4; full-overlap vanishing D_n=0 for P>=sum t_j; continuity C^(n-4) across chamber walls (kink not pole); MANIFEST S_2 x S_{n-2} symmetry; only-smaller-minus-P-enters.
Noted on-shell identity w1^2+w2^2 = sum_{j>=3} w_j^2 => P < sum_plus strictly, so the formula's vanishing region sits just outside the physical locus (self-consistency).
Wrote derivations/round2_telescoping.md; produced figures/round2_structure.png; registered s2_005, s2_006, s2_007, s2_dec_005, s2_dec_006, s2_fig_002.
